summary.en: The card splits into the parts of the product mark, which fly in on arcs; the point lands as the mark dot, the name wipes out, the tagline rises and the closing command types on.
summary.zh: 卡片裂成产品标志的几块，沿弧线飞进去；那个点落成标志上的圆点，名字擦出，标语升起，结尾的命令逐字打出。

fits: The close of a film whose product has a geometric mark and a command to run.
notFor: Marks that are pictures or words only; closings without a command (use a plain lock-up).

intent.en: The object the viewer followed all film becomes the product's mark, and the command to get it is typed, so they leave with a name and an action.
intent.zh: 观众跟了一整片的对象变成产品标志，取用它的命令被打出来，观众带走一个名字和一个动作。

content.en: The product's name (≤ 12 chars), the mark as parts in grid units plus a dot, a tagline (≤ 26 chars / 12 字), a command (≤ 36 chars).
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 12 字符），以网格单位描述的标志块与圆点，一句标语（≤ 26 字符 / 12 字），一条命令（≤ 36 字符）。

fits.zh: 产品有几何标志和可运行命令的片子的收尾。

notFor.zh: 图形或纯文字标志；没有命令的收尾（用普通落版）。

pairs.note: hands it the Run button as the baton

en: Hold the typed command ≥ 3 s; a closing command that vanishes cannot be copied.
zh: 打完的命令至少停 3 秒；一闪而过的结尾命令没法抄。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
